description: Frozen prompt set for the three-arm retrieval parity harness. Each case pins one behaviour of the substring trigger lane that the generated index has to reproduce. Queries are drawn from phrases the corpus actually declares, so a case that returns nothing is evidence about the lane rather than about the fixture.
divergencePolicy: allowedDivergence declares the mechanisms this case predicts. The harness verifies a mechanism for every diverging path individually; a path no mechanism accounts for is unexplained and fails the run, whatever the case declared.

recipeProbe.missPhraseNote: This literal has to stay out of every Markdown document in the corpus. The moment one quotes it, the no-match probe starts exiting 0 and stops distinguishing a clean miss from a broken command.
